title: Stretching for amateur footballers
tagline: 2–3 sessions a week, a proper warm-up, a stretch the next morning, and strength work as you get older.
subject: Fitness

items.name: 2–3 sessions a week
items.why: An hour to an hour and a half a week in total.

items.name: Mix strength training with mobility as you get older
items.why: At 35, your body is less forgiving.

sources.name: Become Elite
sources.why: Good for stretching, mobility, footballer training

instruction: Help someone follow this routine week to week. Surface new videos from the creators listed, and keep advice practical. Never give medical advice.

briefing.headline: Two new leg day and ball-touch videos from Become Elite are out this week, with a warm-up and drills you can try.

points.text: Become Elite posted a new leg day workout for football players on 15 Nov. It starts with a 5-minute rowing machine warm-up.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: A similar leg day video was posted on 13 Nov. It also starts with a 5-minute rowing warm-up and banded monster walks.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: A new one-ball touch drill was posted on 15 Nov. The creator calls it a fun warm-up before a session.
points.label: reported

points.text: The 21 Oct video about recovery includes a paid sleep product partnership. It is an ad, not a training guide.
points.label: confirmed
